description: Bank Makramah Limited, formerly Summit Bank Limited, is a commercial bank in Pakistan. It describes itself as transitioning into a full-fledged Islamic bank following the 2023 acquisition of a 60.45% shareholding by H.E. Nasser Abdulla Hussain Lootah, and reports a network of over 162 branches and 182 ATMs across more than 60 cities, of which 94 branches have been converted into licensed Islamic branches. It offers consumer, corporate, commercial, retail and international banking.
headOffice: No. 13, COM-3, Block 6, Clifton, Karachi, Pakistan
